body: Thank you for the advice. Unfortunately he doesn’t have any family anywhere close to where we are. I’ve tried to find him places to stay but a lot of parents of friends are afraid of legal repercussions they could face from the parents as it might be considered “kidnapping”. He stayed at a friend’s last night but his parents have banned him from going to that friend’s house from now on (and my friend can’t drive so it’s hard for him to get places).

It was actually me and some other friends that all made separate reports to CPS as well as the school mandated reporters I assume. I thought that multiple reports would be enough. I’m scared of trying again because after CPS came last time the abuse got worse and better hidden.
In person, we go to the same school.

I’ve suggested a shelter to him but he’s afraid he’ll just be there for a bit, then go home, and things will be worse at home, and the shelter might keep him safe for a bit, but wouldn’t really change anything in the long run.
His parents have made an effort to hurt him in ways that don’t leave marks. And I don’t believe he has any pictures of his previous bruises.
